An experimental visual short film exploring American suburbia, consumer nostalgia, and the surrealism of everyday life.

An experimental hauntological film following a mallwalker through his final days wandering his local mall, where once-familiar passageways begin to betray the presence of past inhabitants, until their lingering spirits draw him toward a piano store and his memories erupt in a violent wash of color.
An ambient expressionist film following a lone wanderer from the countryside into suburban America, searching for solace in the overlooked back alleys and drifting field recordings of everyday life.

docs.s: Screenplay · 13 pages · by Mayur Pande & Alex Hager
docs.a: dante crow screenplay script mayur pande alex hager hollow point

docs.b: DANTE CROW Written by Mayur Pande & Alex Hager

EXT. THE CITY OF HOLLOW POINT - NIGHT From the heavens, a flier twirls in the wind seemingly with little resistance, until it lands with a splash in a puddle. Water-soaked ink bleeds across the page reading “THE STRINGS BEHIND, SAVE 25% OFF ON YOUR NEXT PURCHASE OF NOTE THEMED MERCHANDISE.” Boots -black and heavy-smash into the puddle, shattering the surface. The paper clings to the sole before the wind takes it away. The man (DANTE CROW) wearing the boots slogs along, as his trench coat drags behind him. His head is low, a collar pulled high. He blends into darkness. DANTE (V.O.) Hollow Point - a city of perpetual twilight, where the lines between savior and sinner blur, and every shadow conceals a story. DANTE (V.O.) In 1992, a devastating earthquake tore through the city, fracturing its foundation and leaving scars that could never fully heal. Yet it unearthed more than rubble. Dante walks through the pale moonlit city, He passes a Poster of an Odd Sigil. DANTE (V.O.) Beneath the streets lay remnants of forgotten cults — cryptic symbols etched into the earth’s bones, whispers of something darker… an ancient, buried power.

2. DANTE (V.O.) From this chaos, two factions emerged. The Hollow Point Union and the Red Dragons. They promised order but delivered only oppression, growing into a plague that swallowed everything — police, politics, and the people themselves. Dante moves deeper into the cityscape, neon flickering as he walks. DANTE (V.O.) By ’94, Hollow Point was a battlefield. Gangs, vigilantes, and power-hungry factions clash in the alleys. Flames light the sky. Dante walks into a dark alley, His shadow grows. DANTE (V.O.) And among them rose a lone figure - an avenger cloaked in darkness, fueled by vengeance. The embodiment of Hollow Point’s fury. A vigilante exposing the cracks in the city’s fragile facade. INT. THE DEN - NIGHT Dante is sitting at a table. In front of him is Boss Franko, a young southern kid in his mid 20s. He has a powerful presence, but soft spoken. But can be aggressive when needed. He is always fixing his jacket, utensils, etc. He is very particular. Setting: a small hidden bar, you need to descend stairs to enter. Dante and his boss discuss recent events affecting the hollow point union.

3. FRANKO You ever notice, Crow, how fast folks forget who owns who? Like their memory just slips right out their heads. He adjusts his glass of water on the table until it sits perfectly aligned with his utensils. FRANKO (CONT'D) The Red Dragons snatched up my bunker. Seventh and Main. Prime Spot. All Mine. They just done walked in there and took it over. They think I’m just supposed to sit here and count change and say thank ya kindly He leans back, voice low and slow. FRANKO (CONT'D) Nah. That ain’t how this works Dante shifts, watching him carefully. DANTE You want it back, boss. FRANKO Damn right I do. But not just back. I want em hurtin, for thinkin they could. FRANKO (CONT'D) That’s where you come in. I don’t care how you do it — fists, fire, hell, sing ‘em a lullaby if that’ll do it. Just make sure when it’s over, that warehouse ours.

4. DANTE If I do this… you’ll hold up your end? A better life, right? Franko leans forward, adjusting his jacket. FRANKO (CONT'D) You got my word, you bring me dat ground and hollow point’ll open up for you. FRANKO (CONT'D) just don’t forgot,Crow, whatever it takes INT. STARLIGHT LOUNGE - NIGHT Cami is sitting at a table waiting for the silence to break. Dante is sitting alongside her. He has a blank stare. Cami notices and reaches across the table and brushes her fingers on his. Cami is a comforting, motherly figure, very soft spoken, can be sensual but mostly very soothing. Always makes Dante’s day better and brightens his mood. CAMI You haven’t said a word since we sat down. DANTE What's to say?

5. DANTE (CONT'D) (voice cracking, raw emotional) My life’s fucked, cami. I-I destroyed it. I followed a crooked man and traded away whatever sanity I had left. It's over. I put a man in the ground. I killed him. (He swallows, gasps for breathe) I thought I could handle it. Thought I could bury it, shove it down, lock it up in me. But it's not buried, I’m sick to my stomach and I can’t puke it up. I just can’t shake it. CAMI (Hands on his, lets out a deep breath) You did what you had to do. It's all to get a better life. You're free now. Dante, what you did doesn't make you a monster. Not to me. We’ll sit together in it. I’m with you. DANTE I don’t deserve you. CAMI Maybe not. But you got me anyway. EXT. ABANDONED LOT - NIGHT

6. In a dark and empty alley, police tape flutters in the wind. Bloody gauze pads lay the asphalt, faint caulk outline of a body in the center of the scene. A short and scrawny young up and coming detective (Maxwell Cornwallis). He is an expressive high energy detective who doesn't let the horrors of his job take over. He is rooted in conspiracy theories and not respected among his colleagues because of it. He crouches over the bloody symbol in the ground. (Irish accent) MAXWELL Christ almighty… another one. Third this month, same sigil. Same mess. And it reeks of a conspiracy. He sketches the sigil into his pad. The pencil scratches. MAXWELL oh brother, This ain’t just gang nonsense, it's like they control the weather in this city. He jumps to his feet, begins to pace, his eyes scan the scene. MAXWELL Whoever’s behind this They’re playing conductor. They think they're clever, but I see the patterns. I see the hand pulling them strings. They think they can put the chemicals in my water. MAXWELL (CONT'D) Well by God, I’ll catch em… I’ll unravel this madness, before more bodies pile up.

7. INT. DANTE’S ROOM - NIGHT Dante lies in bed, asleep. Moonlight spills through his window onto his face. The room is dead silent except for a humming fan. A twitch runs across his body. His chest rises and descends rapidly. He begins to seize, shaking unnaturally like he is being taken control of. CUT TO: The monstrous vigilante stands next to the bed, Dante is gone. The vigilante is draped in clothing, mimicking Harrison Ford Blade runner / Kaneda Akira. He is hooded and has eye shadow. CUT TO: EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT A Hollow Point Union goon rifling through a stolen package, unaware. The vigilante lurks around a corner. It jumps out from the shadows and tackles the goon. The vigilante stands over the body, his chest heaving. It glances to the left where an ODD SIGIL poster is stapled to the wall. It is mesmerized by the sigil. CUT TO: INT. DANTE’S ROOM - NIGHT Dante is back in bed, breathing heavily. Slowly a faint smile is visible on his face. He is asleep. INT. THE DEN - EVENING FRANKO (grinning) You done good crow, real good. Lotta fellas don’t got no stomach for that kinda stuff. Dante Swallows hard. His voice is shaky.

8. DANTE I don’t know if I got a stomach for it either. Franko chuckles, mouth half full. FRANKO You done proved it. No turning back now. Dante stares down at his empty plate, his hands trembling under the table. FRANKO (CONT'D) (Leans in) But then I see you walking around with that floozie. And I reconsider. Dante is startled and looks straight up. DANTE Leave her out of this. Franko wipes his fingers on a napkin, leans back and tosses it on the table. FRANKO Well I can’t do that. You're too wrapped up in her. And weakness? That gets folks killed. FRANKO (CONT'D) So you're gonna bring her in on this next one, So i can keep an eye on the two of you. You call her! Right now! Dante freezes. Then with a crack voice says. DANTE She doesn't belong in this mess.

9. FRANKO (Cutting him off aggressively) You do what I say, Crow! Or You’ll both find out what it means to be on the bad side of the Hollow Point Union. Dante heistily pulls out his nokia from his pocket. His hands shakily call Cami. DANTE (Into the phone, quietly) Cami… It's me. I need you to do somethin’. Just… please go along with it. Dante pauses to let Cami speak, the audience doesn’t hear anything. DANTE Thank you for trusting me. Franko smirks while fixing his jacket. FRANKO Good. Now don’t make me question you again, Crow. INT. STARLIGHT LOUNGE - NIGHT A Red Dragon Goon sits at a booth table in the Starlight Lounge. Cami approaches the table, she is wearing a nice dress. She seems nervous. CAMI Mind If I sit? The Goon looks her over then gestures her to sit RED DRAGON GOON Please, take a seat.

10. She sits beside him, She laughs softly and touches his arm sensually. Then the lights flicker THe vigilante (DANTE in his monstrous form) steps in view. The goon is startled and jumps up. RED DRAGON GOON The Fuck..? The vigilante lunges at him Cami stares motionless gasps, holds her mouth and then screams. The vigilante then turns to her, voice is ragged. Then he speaks. VIGILANTE Do you hear that, Cami? The silence before the flood… the silence before the sword is drawn. Kings once lost their minds to it—Saul raved, Herod slaughtered, mad emperors burned their cities for less. They were hollow vessels much like me with a will not of their own. He inches closer. VIGILANTE The mark is carved. The law is written. There is no mercy for those who stand in its path. You were chosen, not by me, but by the hand that moves through me. I am no man tonight… I am only the weight that falls. And now – judgement has come. Cami backs away, then becomes stunted CAMI …Dante? He then goes in for the kill, lunging at her. Chairs are knocked over, He grabs her neck he chokes her on the floor, killing her right there.

11. EXT ALLEYWAY - NIGHT The vigilante lurks through the alley running from the crime scene. He stumbles - slam his head against a brick wall. When he opens his eyes. It's DANTE inside the costume. He stares at his hands and his clothes and begins to tremble. A flood of memories rush across his face through his expressions. His face twitches. He collapses on the pavement and goes silent then he begins to scream his voice cracks head still buried in the concrete. DANTE Why did I kill her? He screams till his voice gives out. INT. PIANO ROOM - NIGHT A small dark damp room, with a grand piano sits in the center. Dante sits at the keys. Head hunched over, his hands trembling before they found their place on keys. Then he begins to play a sad ballet. The final note hangs then he presses a low key then silence. Dante lowers the cover slowly as it clicks. He reaches into his coat pocket. A Pill Bottle. Not labeled, white capsules. He stares at it for a moment. Then he tips the bottle into his mouth then swallows. INT. OFFICE - NIGHT A small desk in a dim white room is covered in a mountain of files and an empty coffee cup. Maxwell flips through his notepad frantically. His eyes screen the room looking for something. The SIGIL is scrawled over all the paperwork in the room. MAXWELL I ain’t no hatter. The brass, the union boys, the Red Dragons all of ‘em. They think it’s just some turf war. He slams the notepad down and shoves a stack of folders to the floor.

12. MAXWELL I’ve seen it. The pattern. The mark. It’s in the bricks, the alleys, you don’t just violate the walls for subjugation. No, no, no — It's a cult. He sketches furiously, He takes the Sigil and turns it into puppet strings He stares at it, trembling. MAXWELL Somebody’s pullin’ the strings. MATCH CUT TO: EXT. ALLEYWAY - NIGHT A FIGURE stands Puppet strings dangling from his gloved hand. The detective’s frantic VOICE bleeds over. MAXWELL (V.O.) Well Well Well. CUT TO BLACK.

TAKEN IN SCOTLAND, THIS IMAGE CAPTURES THE GRANDIOSITY THAT CERTAIN BUILDINGS CAN EMBODY THE MOMENT YOU STEP INSIDE. THE MALL'S SWEEPING STAIRCASES AND LAYERED BALCONIES CREATE A VISUAL MAZE, GIVING THE ILLUSION OF ENDLESS EXPLORATION. IT’S EASY TO FEEL LOST AMONG THE INTRICATE PATHS AND STOREFRONTS, AS IF THE SPACE IS MUCH LARGER THAN IT TRULY IS. YET, MUCH OF WHAT SURROUNDS YOU IS AMBIENT, OPEN SPACE FRAMED WITH INTENTION. THE WARM BROWNS AND MUTED GREENS EVOKE THE CALM AND DEPTH OF A FOREST, SUBTLY CONNECTING THE URBAN ENVIRONMENT TO SOMETHING MORE ORGANIC. THE MALL BECOMES MORE THAN A IT TRANSFORMS INTO A MAN- INVITING VISITORS TO ITS INDOOR IN THIS WAY, COMMERCIAL HUB, MADE WOODLAND, WANDER AND WONDER AMIDST CANOPY
JULY 2023 hate spade

THE REFRESHMENTS STAND AT A MOVIE THEATER IS SOMETHING WE EITHER CHERISH OR DESPISE. A GOOD MOVIE IS ALWAYS BETTER WITH A SNACK, BUT THEATERS OFTEN PRICE THEM SO HIGH THAT IT HARDLY FEELS WORTH IT. YET, THESE SALES ARE WHAT HELP KEEP THE THEATER RUNNING. THINK OF ALL THE MEMORIES, THE ATMOSPHERE, THE EXPERIENCE OF BEING THERE. IT’S A HARSH TRADE-OFF BETWEEN COST AND EXPERIENCE—ONE WE’RE FORCED TO NAVIGATE. NOW, MANY OF THESE STANDS, AND EVEN SOME THEATERS, SIT COMPLETELY ABANDONED.
JULY 2023 g

PLANES HAVE BECOME THE ULTIMATE ALLEYWAY BETWEEN TWO TOTALLY DIFFERENT UNIVERSES. IT’S THE CONNECTIVE TISSUE THAT ENABLES MEMORIES TO FORM. THERE’S SOMETHING ABOUT BEING SUSPENDED ABOVE THE WORLD THAT FEELS BOTH SURREAL AND GROUNDING AT THE SAME TIME. DESPITE THIS, THE EXPERIENCE OF FLYING IS OFTEN SEEN AS TIRESOME AND GRUELLING. LONG LINES, INVASIVE SECURITY, DELAYS, AND THE MAZE OF TERMINALS REDUCE SOMETHING EXTRAORDINARY INTO A ROUTINE. THE JOURNEY BECOMES CUMBERSOME, EVEN IF THE DESTINATION HOLDS MEANING. I'VE TRAVELLED ACROSS EUROPE AND THROUGH IT, ASIA. BUT INDIA REMAINS THE MOST FAMILIAR YET EMOTIONALLY COMPLEX DESTINATION. BEING AN INDIAN AMERICAN OFTEN LABELLED AS AN “ABCD” COMES WITH THE SAME SHARED EXPERIENCES. FROM THE MINUTE WE’RE BORN, WE’RE ARMED WITH THE SAME BAG OF RHETORIC THAT WE REGURGITATE TO OTHER PEOPLE OF THE COMMUNITY WHEN WE MEET THEM. CONVERSATIONS TEND TO FOLLOW FAMILIAR PATTERNS, ONE OF THE MOST FAMOUS BEING: “HOW OFTEN DO YOU GO TO INDIA?” I WILL ADMIT THAT I’VE GROWN PRETTY RESENTFUL TOWARDS MY ALLEGED “MOTHERLAND”, BUT IT STILL DOESN’T TAKE AWAY FROM THE FACT THAT I’VE FORMED SOME OF MY MOST OBSCURE, BUT FOND MEMORIES WHILE IN THE AIR.
JULY 2023

TAKEN IN PUNE, INDIA BY MEMEVIK. IN INDIA, APARTMENT COMPLEXES ARE CALLED "SOCIETIES". THIS WAS ON SET FOR THE NOW DELETED “BAD MOVIES" SONG FROM THE SCRAPPED "“AWOF" ALBUM. JUST AN EDGY PICTURE SURE, BUT IT REPRESENTS THE DYNAMICS OF LIVING ON TOP OF ANOTHER WHICH IS THE REALITY FOR MANY INDIANS ACROSS THE COUNTRY. THE DIM, GRAINY LIGHTING AND TIGHT CORNER EVOKE THE BOXED-IN NATURE OF URBAN LIFE, WHERE PEOPLE LIVE STACKED ABOVE EACH OTHER, NAVIGATING SHARED SPACE AND BLURRED IDENTITY. IT’S A SMALL MOMENT, BUT IT SPEAKS TO A MUCH LARGER STRUCTURE.
AUGUST 2023

TAKEN AT RAGA RECORDINGS, MY FIRST STUDIO SESSION WHERE ME AND MY CREW RECORDED THE "IT'S GETTING LATE" ALBUM. A MONUMENTAL MOMENT IN MY CAREER FINALLY VOCALS THAT AREN’T DISTORTED AND CRUSTY AS SHIT FROM THE HEADSET I USUALLY USE! THE STUDIO WAS SMALL, WHICH MADE THE EXPERIENCE FEEL MORE PERSONAL. RO, THE ENGINEER WAS REALLY SUPPORTIVE, GIVING ME ADVICE AND EVEN LOVING SOME OF THE TRACKS I RECORDED THERE. AN UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE FOR SURE, AND A MAJOR MILESTONE IN MY CREATIVE LIFE.
DECEMBER 2023

ON THE SAME DAY AS THE RAGA RECORDING, MY CREW AND I SHOT THE TRAILER FOR IT'S GETTING LATE AT BROADWAY MALL. SADLY, THE MALL IS SLOWLY DYING, WHICH IS UNFORTUNATE BECAUSE I HAVE A LOT OF MEMORIES TIED TO THAT PLACE. IT SERVES AS A REMINDER NOT TO TAKE THINGS FOR GRANTED WHEN WE HAVE THEM—A LESSON PEOPLE HAVE HEARD COUNTLESS TIMES BUT RARELY SEEM TO LEARN.
DECEMBER 2023

THIS PHOTO WAS TAKEN AT MY HOUSE USING A NINTENDO 3DS. THE 3DS CAPTURES A UNIQUE LIMINAL AESTHETIC—NOT AS GRAINY AS VHS, BUT IT REPRESENTS A 2000S AESTHETIC THAT I'M VERY ATTACHED TO, AN ERA I’M DEEPLY ATTACHED TO. MY HOUSE REFLECTS THAT CLASSIC 2000S SUBURBAN ARCHITECTURAL STYLE I’VE COME TO LOVE. IT’S NOT EXTRAVAGANT OR FANCY—IT’S HOME, AND IT’S BEEN THAT WAY FOR 18 YEARS. BECAUSE OF OUR LAZINESS, MY FAMILY NEVER TOOK DOWN THE CHRISTMAS TREE, WHICH HAS ALMOST BECOME AN ICONIC FIXTURE, ADDING CHARACTER, NOSTALGIA, AND DETAIL TO THE HOUSE.
FEBRUARY 2024

TAKEN AT CHINATOWN PLAZA IN LAS VEGAS, THE SHEER SERENITY AND AMBIANCE I EXPERIENCED THERE FELT UNREAL. EVERYONE WAS INCREDIBLY KIND, FRIENDLY, AND WELCOMING. THE NEON LIGHTING HIGHLIGHTED THE ARCHITECTURAL BEAUTY OF THE SPACE, CREATING A STRIKING ATMOSPHERE. ALTHOUGH I HAD NEVER BEEN THERE BEFORE, IT FELT ODDLY FAMILIAR—EVOKING AN UNEXPLAINABLE SENSE OF ANEMOIA THAT I’VE BEEN CHASING EVER SINCE. THIS PLACE REPRESENTS THE SMALL BUSINESS SECTOR OF AMERICA AND HOW IMMIGRANTS LIKE ME AND MY FAMILY COME HERE SEEKING OPPORTUNITIES UNAVAILABLE ELSEWHERE. IT’S JUST A COMMUNITY OF EVERYDAY PEOPLE KEEPING A BIG DREAM ALIVE.
MARCH 2024

ALSO TAKEN AT THE CHINATOWN PLAZA IN LAS VEGAS. THE NEON REALLY SHINES LIGHT ON THE RATHER DARK ALLEYWAYS THAT LINE THE ENTIRE STRUCTURE. ANOTHER EXAMPLE OF HOW UNIQUE LIGHTING CAN ELEVATE A CERTAIN ARCHITECTURAL STYLE AND GIVE IT A STYLE THAT IS BOTH FUNCTIONAL AND FORMAL. IT WAS ALSO AROUND CLOSING TIME, SO IT REPRESENTS THE SLOWNESS FELT BY THE PLAZA AS THE NIGHT CONTINUED TO FALL.
MARCH 2024

THE LAST PICTURE TAKEN AT THE CHINATOWN PLAZA IN LAS VEGAS. THIS WAS INSIDE THE MAIN "MALL" PORTION, LINED WITH SEVERAL SMALL BUSINESSES THAT HAD SIGNS WRITTEN IN CHINESE CHARACTERS THAT I DIDN’T UNDERSTAND, BUT REGARDLESS, FELT LIKE HOME. I THINK THIS ONE IN PARTICULAR WAS AN ANTIQUE STORE, BUT I CAN’T QUITE PUT MY FINGER ON IT. EVERY STORE HAD ITS OWN NEON-COLORED HEADER THAT LINED THE TOP OF THE STRUCTURE, AND EACH ONE WAS COLORED UNIQUELY FOR EACH STORE. THIS ONE POPPED OUT TO ME THE MOST.
N N <x

TAKEN NEAR MY HOUSE. THIS WAS THE ORIGINAL COVER MADE FOR MY “ITS GETTING LATE” ALBUM. THE IDEA WAS FANTASTIC, BUT IT EVENTUALLY GOT SCRAPPED BECAUSE STREAMING SERVICES WOULDN’T ACCEPT IT. SINCE MY NAME IS ORIGAMI ULTRA, I HAD TO USE THE “ULTRA” GAS STATION AS THE BACKDROP. THIS REPRESENTS, AGAIN, THE DESIRE FOR SLOWNESS THAT SHOULD BE AN ACCESSIBLE AND COMMON INTEREST AMONG PEOPLE. IT SHOWS THE CERTAIN SERENITY ONE FEELS WHEN MAYBE LEAVING WORK TO GO HOME—THAT LITTLE IN-BETWEEN PERIOD WHERE LIFE JUST SEEMS TO SLOW DOWN FOR ONCE.
APRIL 2024

TAKEN AT THE "MALL AT THE SOURCE,” A DEAD MALL IN MY AREA. I'M NOT REALLY ATTACHED TO THIS MALL, WAS NEVER THERE WHEN IT WAS IN ITS HEYDAY, BUT THE OVERALL FEELING OF BEING IN A DEAD MALL IS VERY SURREAL. AS I IT'S A LIMINAL SPACE, A PLACE THAT'S SUPPOSED TO BE BUSTLING WITH LIFE, BUT JUST ISN'T. IT'S ALMOST LIKE YOU'RE WALKING BY GHOSTS OF PEOPLE WHO ONCE CALLED THIS MALL THEIR "HOME" FOR HANGOUTS, DATES, AND SPECIAL MOMENTS—OR EVEN LITTLE MOMENTS, FOR THAT MATTER. WHAT WAS ONCE A BEACON OF CAPITALISM NOW JUST A SHELL OF ITS FORMER SELF, ROTTING AWAY AS TECHNOLOGY REPLACED ITS FUNCTION. IS
APRIL 2024

ALSO TAKEN AT THE MALL AT THE SOURCE. THIS WAS IN THE BACKROOMS PORTION. THE BACKROOMS IS A PHENOMENON THAT SPARKED THE LIMINAL SPACE CRAZE. IT’S A FEELING OF “WHAT’S AROUND THE OTHER CORNER?” IT’S A QUESTION ONE POSES WHILE EXPLORING THESE ABANDONED STRUCTURES, BUT ALSO WHEN WE’RE ABOUT TO ENTER A NEW CHAPTER IN OUR LIFE. THERE COULD BE TRASH OR TREASURE-THE ONLY WAY YOU FIND OUT IS TO WALK AROUND THE CORNER.
APRIL 2024

LAST PICTURE TAKEN AT THE DEAD MALL AT THE SOURCE. THIS LATER SERVED AS THE INSPIRATION FOR THE "SO I STOOD WAITING...” ALBUM COVER. AS STATED BEFORE, THE ONLY WAY TO CHANGE YOUR LIFE AND TAKE ADVANTAGE OF NEW OPPORTUNITIES IS TO TURN THE CORNER. WE WANT CHANGE SO BADLY, BUT DREAD IT ONCE IT ACTUALLY OCCURS. WE WOULD RATHER SIT IN A DEAD MALL THAT HOLDS THE GHOSTS OF MEMORIES THAN GO TO A NEW MALL BUSTLING WITH FRESH IDEAS AND MEMORIES. HIS WAS THE PREMISE OF THE SCRAPPED BUT NOT SHELVED FILM THAT WAS MEANT TO ACCOMPANY THE “IT'S GETTING LATE” ALBUM.
APRIL 2024

TAKEN AT THE TRI COUNTY FLEA MARKET, A LOCALLY OWNED SPOT THAT USUALLY DOESN’T SEE MUCH TRAFFIC. IT’S SAD FOR THE OWNERS, BUT IT PERFECTLY CAPTURES THE TRUE FEELING OF WALKING THROUGH A DESOLATE PLAZA—THE FEELING OF SOLITUDE. NORMALLY, BEING ALONE FEELS SCARY SINCE HUMANS ARE SOCIAL CREATURES, BUT HERE, SOLITUDE FELT STRANGELY COMFORTING. THERE’S SOMETHING NOSTALGIC ABOUT SEEING THE THINGS YOU ONCE KNEW AS A KID, BUT NOW THROUGH A NEW LENS AS YOU MATURE AND GROW. THE QUIET STILLNESS INVITES REFLECTION—A REMINDER THAT PLACES, LIKE PEOPLE, CHANGE OVER TIME, YET SOME MEMORIES REMAIN UNTOUCHED, QUIETLY WAITING TO BE REDISCOVERED.

TAKEN AT A SUMP IN MY NEIGHBORHOOD. IT’S A STRANGE, SOMEWHAT HIDDEN OFF FROM THE REST OF SOCIETY, TUCKED AWAY LIKE A FORGOTTEN CORNER. BECAUSE OF ITS ISOLATION, IT’S OFTEN A HOTSPOT FOR DELINQUENT ACTIVITY. YET, DESPITE ITS ROUGH REPUTATION, IT HOLDS A UNIQUE KIND OF SIGNIFICANCE. IT’S ALMOST LIKE AN “OUTSIDE” VERSION OF THE LIMINAL SPACES WE OFTEN TALK ABOUT—PLACES THAT EXIST ON THE EDGE OF EVERYDAY LIFE, SUSPENDED BETWEEN WHAT IS AND WHAT COULD BE. THIS SUMP IS A PLACE NOBODY IS REALLY SUPPOSED TO ENTER, BUT IT QUIETLY DRAWS YOUNG PEOPLE WHO SEEK A REFUGE AWAY FROM THE RULES AND EXPECTATIONS OF THE WORLD. HERE, AMID THE SHADOWS AND CRACKED PAVEMENT, MEMORIES ARE MADE—SOMETIMES RECKLESS, SOMETIMES MEANINGFUL. IT’S A RAW, UNPOLISHED SPACE THAT REFLECTS THE RESTLESS ENERGY OF YOUTH, A SECRET STAGE WHERE MOMENTS UNFOLD AWAY FROM THE SPOTLIGHT, YET LEAVE LASTING IMPRESSIONS.
FEBRUARY 2025

TAKEN BEHIND A LAUNDROMAT IN HICKSVILLE, THIS PHOTO SHOWS A QUIET, ALMOST FORGOTTEN SPACE THE EMPTY BACK LOT, STILL AND OVERLOOKED. WHILE THE FRONT MIGHT BE BUSY WITH CARS AND PEOPLE, THE BACK TELLS A DIFFERENT STORY. ABOVE IT ALL, THE SKY IS HEAVY WITH CLOUDS, CASTING A MUTED LIGHT OVER THE SCENE. IN THE BACKGROUND, THE SPIRE OF A CHURCH RISES JUST ENOUGH TO BE NOTICED. THERE’S SOMETHING ABOUT THAT MIX, ORDINARY BUILDING, THE QUIET LOT, THE DARKENING SKY, AND THE PRESENCE OF SOMETHING BIGGER IN THE DISTANCE. THE IT FEELS LIKE ONE OF THOSE IN-BETWEEN SPACES, NOT FULLY HERE OR THERE, WHERE THINGS SLOW DOWN AND YOU’RE LEFT WITH WHATEVER’S REAL. IT SAYS SOMETHING ABOUT HOW LIFE CAN LOOK FULL FROM THE OUTSIDE, BUT FEEL QUIET ON THE INSIDE.
MAY 2025

SHOT IN THE FLAGSTAR PARKING LOT, DURING THE SHOOT FOR “THINGS LIKE THAT”. IT CAPTURES THAT IN-BETWEEN FEELING LOST IN A PHONE CALL WHILE EVERYTHING ELSE FADES INTO THE BACKGROUND. THE HARSH LIGHTING, THE EMPTY STRUCTURE, THE COLD CONCRETE IT’S ANOTHER OUTSIDE LIMINAL SPACE. IT REMINDS ME HOW OFTEN WE’RE SOMEWHERE, BUT NOT REALLY THERE.
MAY 2025

SHOT BY THE HICKSVILLE TRAIN STATION. I WANTED THIS ONE TO REPRESENT MOVEMENT TRAINS COME AND GO, AND SO DO MOMENTS IN LIFE. STANDING STILL WHILE EVERYTHING AROUND YOU IS BUILT TO MOVE SAYS A LOT. 2025 IS THE YEAR I’VE FULLY LOCKED IN, NO MORE HALF-STEPPING, I’M TRULY IN IT NOW. THIS SPOT FELT LIKE THE PERFECT SYMBOL FOR THAT, NOT WHERE I STOP, BUT WHERE I START MOVING FORWARD.
MAY 2025

THIS IS THE COVER FOR MY FIFTH ALBUM “So I STOOD WAITING...” IF IT LOOKS FAMILIAR, IT’S A VISUAL CONTINUATION OF THE EARLIER EXIT SIGN PHOTO FROM THE MALL AT THE SOURCE. SHOT IN HICKSVILLE TRAIN STATION, RIGHT UNDER THE EXIT SIGN. THE BLURRED FIGURE IN FRONT IS ME, IN MOTION, BUT NOT REALLY GOING ANYWHERE. IT REPRESENTS THE MENTAL FOG THAT COMES WHEN YOUR MIND’S MOVING TOO FAST TO FOCUS. IT’S NOT FROM A LACK OF IDEAS, IT’S THE OPPOSITE. IT REPRESENTS THE OVERLOAD OF TRYING TO DO SOMETHING REAL WHILE LIFE KEEPS THROWING YOU CURVE BALLS. IN FRONT OF ME, THAT STILL FIGURE IN THE MASK IS LIKE A PHYSICAL FORM OF ALL THE STUFF THAT PREVENTING ME FROM THE EXIT DOUBT, BURNOUT, ANXIETY. THIS PHOTO CAPTURES THAT IN-BETWEEN, TRYING TO MOVE FORWARD, TO EXIT THAT HEAD SPACE, BUT STILL FEELING PULLED BACK BY WHAT’S STANDING IN THE WAY
MAY 2025
